payload.title: Place chart and practice sheet

sections.heading: Prerequisite fallback
sections.text: Draw columns labelled tens and ones. Put 4 in tens and 2 in ones. Explain how 42 differs from 24. If unsure, make four groups of ten marks and two single marks. Repeat with 31, then remove the drawing.

sections.heading: Faded decimal support
sections.text: Add tenths and hundredths columns. Place 3.25 in the chart. State each digit's value. Cover the labels and explain 7.46. Finally work without the chart: compare 0.2 and 0.19 using equal place units.
